stage: V27 cheap waiting controls on the existing six-root panel
frozen_inputs: Read reconstruction_v26/selection.json, reconstruction_v25/model_fit.json and city_transfer_endpoints.json.gz unchanged. Both 20-second laws, all six five-offer roots including the positive case, original menu, MCT, 30-second publication, 40-minute cap and downstream first-offer rescue.

new_controls.schedule_priority: At each public offer rank the union of visible and still-unseen candidates by frozen scheduled final arrival then ID. Board if the best is visible; otherwise wait. Remove only public seen receipts, not candidates whose scheduled departure has passed. No model-score preparation.
new_controls.single_target_nominal: For each unseen candidate compute the conditional expected nominal cost of waiting exclusively for that candidate, keeping unobserved pre-entry, cancellation and post-deadline mass. Compare the best such wait with the best currently visible nominal board cost. Reconsider at every public opportunity without locking a target. Compile per-trip suffix mass and savings, not subset states. Uses the identical V26 clock_nominal board scores and departure laws.
new_controls.combined_wait_nominal: Before any V27 outcomes, add the parameter-free combination: compare current board with the smaller of the existing future-first-offer wait and best single-target wait. This retains both complementary rescue and deliberate skipping of intermediate offers without full subset DP.

reason_for_two_controls: Pure timetable priority tests whether waiting for the planned-best route explains the actual panel. The stronger conditional single-target control prevents the comparison from relying on timetable priority ignoring missed or canceled trips. Neither rule or threshold will be tuned to the new results.
reused_worlds: Exactly the 1536 V26 full-trip worlds, 128 per root/law, entropy [20261112,26,law_index,root_index] and the original full root/tail trip set. Reconstruct because events were not serialized. Run only new policies plus the cheap first-offer reproduction check; retain old one-step/DP outcomes. No new independent evaluation sample is claimed.
evaluation: Pair actual and simulated physical losses/arrivals with archived V26 controls. Exactly integrate all three new policies under the nominal proxy law and compare every supported state against archived DP values. Preserve every harm and failure, with within-root Monte Carlo variance combined by equal root weights.
verification: Independent micro-world enumeration for target expectations and policy integration; no unobserved past is deleted. Assert first-offer action, tail, loss, arrived and status reproduce V26 in every regenerated world. Stop for an implementation/source discrepancy rather than extending or retuning the experiment.
cost: Measure pure priority construction and online calls without model charges. For single-target account fresh per-root belief and nominal-score preparation, suffix compilation, and online calls; shared data/menu loading separately. Existing DP costs remain explicitly V26 measurements, not a fresh simultaneous benchmark. Exact evaluation/sampling are offline diagnostics, not online decision cost.
decision: Both actual and model evidence remain development diagnostics. If a cheap control reproduces the DP benefit, do not attribute it to full DP. Residual gains must be reported against its additional cost and generic-planning alternatives before considering G2. No new date, enlarged menu, parameter search, certificate or manuscript rewrite in this stage.
